title: Fourth Row
alt: Four panels. 1: Pip holds a mustard folder and reads out a case: a navy coat missing one four-hole button. Margo, behind her desk next to a red button tin, says to check the tin. 2: Close-up of Pip, wide-eyed, saying there are hundreds; a voice from off-panel says two hundred and eleven. 3: Top-down view of the open tin: rows of buttons, each with a tiny paper tag. A voice reads tags like 'Green. Bus seat.' and 'Brown. Laughed.' and says navy is in the fourth row. A red ring marks the navy button. 4: Pip points out that Margo's top cardigan button does not match; it is a small pearly one among the others. Margo, deadpan, says it is very well documented.
hover: Fourth row, third from the left. She has never once needed to look.
transcript: Panel 1 – PIP: Case 4811. Navy coat, one button missing, four holes.
Panel 2 – MARGO (off-panel): Two hundred and eleven.
Panel 4 – PIP: Your top button doesn't match.
Panel 4 – MARGO: It's very well documented.
note: Every button in the tin has a tag. I'd tell you where they came from, but Margo has it in writing and I'm not allowed to look.
